image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) applied to a textured brown surface. The bandage features a central absorbent pad with a visible woven texture and a small dark spot in the center. The adhesive wings extend outward, showing perforations for breathability. The lighting is warm and diffuse.

Slight softness/blur at the boundaries where the bandage meets the background, potentially indicating edge bleeding or depth-of-field simulation issues.
